note: Annual election of three commissioners, ordinary day moved to 15 October 1937. Four nominations were received; two withdrew, leaving William Smyth and Joseph M'Keown Henshaw returned unopposed, and the third seat was expected to be filled by the co-option of F. S. Neill. The ordinary day moved to 15 October 1937; returned unopposed. (round folder corrected from "1937-10-15 approx", 5 Nov 2026) Two of the four nominees withdrew, so Smyth and Henshaw were returned unopposed; the remaining seat was expected to go to the retiring chairman F. S. Neill by co-option, not by election. Returned unopposed.
